import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 sc='sched_dep' if 'sched_dep' in d else 'sched_dep_utc'; ac='actual_dep' if 'actual_dep' in d else 'actual_dep_utc'
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 busy=d.groupby('route').size(); maxn=busy.max(); b=sorted(busy[busy==maxn].index.tolist())
 x=d[d.cancelled==False].copy(); raw=(pd.to_datetime(x[ac],format='%H:%M')-pd.to_datetime(x[sc],format='%H:%M')).dt.total_seconds()/60
 x['delay']=raw.where(raw>=-60,raw+1440); x['delayed']=x.delay>15
 g=x.groupby('route').agg(completed=('flight_id','size'), delayed=('delayed','sum')); g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed
 eligible=g[g.completed>=20]; mr=eligible.rate.max(); w=sorted(eligible[eligible.rate==mr].index.tolist())
 out[c]={'busiest':b,'busiest_n':int(maxn),'worst':w,'worst_rate':float(mr),'worst_counts':eligible.loc[w].to_dict('index')}
print(out)

events.notes: Loaded each carrier file, deduplicated by the documented unique flight_id, normalized each route by alphabetically sorting its airport codes, and counted all records for busiest routes. For worst routes, excluded cancellations, computed clock-time departure delays (handling after-midnight departures), applied the >15-minute rule, and compared only routes with at least 20 completed flights. No ties occurred for the selected results.

import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}; details={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:-4]; d=pd.read_csv(f)
 # normalize columns including AS UTC
 datecol='date' if 'date' in d else 'date_utc'; sched='sched_dep' if 'sched_dep' in d else 'sched_dep_utc'; actual='actual_dep' if 'actual_dep' in d else 'actual_dep_utc'
 d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol])
 d=d[(d.date.dt.year==2025)&(d.date.dt.month.isin([1,2]))]
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 d['cancel']=d.cancelled.astype(str).str.lower().eq('true')
 # minutes modular only actual after midnight; use datetime date + time and add if actual clock less sched
 def delay(r):
  if r.cancel or pd.isna(r[actual]): return pd.NA
  sh,sm=map(int,str(r[sched]).split(':')); ah,am=map(int,str(r[actual]).split(':'))
  x=(ah*60+am)-(sh*60+sm)
  return x+1440 if x < -720 else x # likely next day, robust
 d['delay']=d.apply(delay,axis=1)
 g=d.groupby('route').agg(scheduled=('flight_id','size'), completed=('cancel',lambda x:(~x).sum()), delayed=('delay',lambda x:(pd.to_numeric(x,errors='coerce')>15).sum()))
 g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed
 busiest=g.sort_values(['scheduled'],ascending=False)
 eligible=g[g.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate','delayed','completed'],ascending=[False,False,True])
 print(c, '\n',g.sort_values('scheduled',ascending=False).head(5), '\neligible',eligible.sort_values('rate',ascending=False).head(5))
 out[c]={'busiest':busiest.index[0], 'worst':eligible.index[0]}
print('OUT',out)

import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}; details={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 # restrict dates based date column (all expected Jan-Feb)
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'
 d[datecol]=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol])
 d=d[d[datecol].dt.to_period('M').astype(str).isin(['2025-01','2025-02'])]
 d['route']=d[['origin','dest']].apply(lambda x:'-'.join(sorted(x)),axis=1)
 # scheduled busiest
 sched=d.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
 busiest=sched.index[0]
 # delay minutes clock, account crossing midnight by modulo? actual-sched, if negative add 1440, but early actual gives negative and should remain. Distinguish overnight: scheduled/actual dates unavailable. Since delays likely <=, negative means early; if actual earlier by >? use raw and likely overnight cases can detect large negative as +1440.
 sc=pd.to_datetime(d[('sched_dep_utc' if datecol=='date_utc' else 'sched_dep')],format='%H:%M')
 ac=pd.to_datetime(d[('actual_dep_utc' if datecol=='date_utc' else 'actual_dep')],format='%H:%M',errors='coerce')
 mins=(ac-sc).dt.total_seconds()/60
 mins=mins.where(mins>=-180, mins+1440) # overnight
 d['delay']=mins
 d['completed']=~d.cancelled.astype(bool)
 d['delayed']=d.completed & (d.delay>15)
 g=d[d.completed].groupby('route').agg(completed=('completed','size'), delayed=('delayed','sum'))
 g=g[g.completed>=20].copy(); g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed
 g=g.sort_values(['rate','delayed'],ascending=False)
 worst=g.index[0]
 out[c]={'busiest':busiest,'worst':worst}
 details[c]=(sched.head(5),g.sort_values('rate',ascending=False).head(10))
 print(c, out[c], '\n busiest',sched.head(5).to_dict(), '\n worst',g.head(5).to_dict('index'))
print(out)
